items.statement: The submission independently optimizes neutral CHClF2 and CHClF2+ with the declared charge/multiplicity and uses their relaxed electronic energies for AIE.
items.expected: Neutral singlet and monocation doublet are converged and charge/spin assignments are explicit.

items.statement: Both named product channels have continuous, charge-conserving paths to separated products, with a defensible choice of relaxed scan or multidimensional path treatment.
items.expected: CHF2+ + Cl and CHFCl+ + F endpoints and path-validation evidence are individually identified.

items.statement: The adiabatic first ionization energy is approximately 11.9 eV.
The CHF2+ + Cl channel has an appearance energy of approximately 12.4 eV.
The CHFCl+ + F channel has an appearance energy of approximately 13.5 eV.
